policy.completion_rule: A capability is complete only when its computed stage reaches PRODUCTION_READY; file/class existence is never completion.
policy.exception_process: Any new capability foundation before the active epic is PRODUCTION_READY requires an explicit reviewed exception in the PR rationale.

capabilities.title: Battery Thevenin 1RC
capabilities.summary: Dynamic discharge/rest 1RC kernel exists, but it is not yet a formal production model/realization and has no fitted or held-out evidence path.
next_actions: Raw NASA ingestion and deterministic cycle segmentation.
R0/R1/C1 + OCV identification on calibration cells.
Held-out validation with quantitative Rint-vs-1RC metrics.
Measurement/parameter/discrepancy uncertainty closure.
Only then register 1RC in claims and BatteryDomainPack.

execution.next_action: Add formal ScientificModelDefinition + realization + end-to-end battery execution route for 1RC.

provenance_replay.next_action: Bind a formal 1RC model/realization identity and selected parameter set into replay/provenance artifacts.

real_data.next_action: Ingest pinned NASA single-cell raw files and build reproducible discharge/pulse/rest traces.

calibration.next_action: Implement OCV/R0/R1/C1 identification with calibration cells frozen before validation.

independent_validation.next_action: Evaluate frozen parameters on held-out cells/cycles.

measurement_uq.next_action: Attach calibrated voltage/current/temperature measurement uncertainty or keep evidence inadmissible.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Publish Rint vs 1RC RMSE, MAE, bias, max error and residual autocorrelation on held-out data.

parameter_uq.next_action: Propagate uncertainty in OCV/R0/R1/C1, including dependencies where supported by evidence.

numerical_uq.rationale: The current constant-current 1RC state transition is closed form; no discretization solver is used in this kernel.

model_discrepancy.next_action: Estimate context-dependent model/data discrepancy on held-out measurements after known uncertainty is accounted for.

claims_integration.next_action: Expose the validated 1RC realization to claim planning without auto-strengthening verdicts.

domainpack_integration.next_action: Promote 1RC into BatteryDomainPack only after formal model/realization and validation gates are satisfied.

capabilities.title: Battery Rint production route
capabilities.summary: Existing Rint/OCV battery route executes and is exposed to claims, but it lacks real held-out validation and production UQ closure.
next_actions: Establish a pinned real-data Rint baseline.
Add measurement and parameter UQ.
Measure held-out discrepancy and benchmark metrics.

real_data.next_action: Run the production Rint route against a pinned single-cell held-out measurement set.

calibration.rationale: The current production route consumes declared cell parameters rather than a repository-owned fitted Rint parameter set.

independent_validation.next_action: Validate voltage/runtime predictions on independent cells/cycles.

measurement_uq.next_action: Attach calibrated measurement uncertainty to external battery evidence.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Publish quantitative held-out Rint metrics as the baseline for richer battery models.

parameter_uq.next_action: Quantify uncertainty of declared cell parameters and propagate it through the route.

numerical_uq.rationale: The Rint electrical relation and current constant-current state updates are closed form.

model_discrepancy.next_action: Quantify residual model discrepancy on real measurements.

capabilities.title: NAFEMS P18.T3 thermal benchmark
capabilities.summary: Benchmark-specific transient conduction route has an external oracle and numerical refinement, but Thermal is not yet normalized into a Domain Pack.
next_actions: Normalize thermal/thermal_models ownership.
Create ThermalDomainPack without changing scientific authority.
Re-run benchmark and provenance regression after normalization.

real_data.rationale: This capability is a fixed external verification benchmark, not an experimental measurement workflow.

calibration.rationale: The NAFEMS T3 operating point is fixed; no parameters are fitted.

measurement_uq.rationale: The evidence route is a benchmark target, not calibrated sensor measurements.

parameter_uq.rationale: The benchmark inputs are fixed by the external case rather than uncertain fitted parameters.

model_discrepancy.rationale: This route verifies a benchmark-specific numerical implementation rather than calibrating an empirical model against measurements.

domainpack_integration.next_action: Create ThermalDomainPack and expose the T3 benchmark through the same atomic domain contract.

capabilities.title: Electrothermal DC/thermal route
capabilities.summary: Executable electrothermal route and cross-solver support exist, but real measurement validation and full UQ/benchmark closure are incomplete.
next_actions: Add a real electrothermal measurement pack.

real_data.next_action: Add a pinned experimental electrothermal dataset spanning current and temperature.

calibration.next_action: Define a frozen material/TCR calibration protocol when parameters are fitted from data.

independent_validation.next_action: Validate against held-out experiments, not only an alternate solver.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Publish held-out error/coverage metrics and native-vs-independent-solver metrics.

numerical_uq.next_action: Generalize numerical uncertainty across the production electrothermal route.

model_discrepancy.next_action: Estimate residual context-dependent discrepancy against measurements.

domainpack_integration.next_action: Create ElectricalDomainPack and declare native/external routes atomically.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Publish error and conservation metrics over a declared benchmark suite.

numerical_uq.next_action: Quantify solver tolerance/stiffness sensitivity for supported regimes.

model_discrepancy.next_action: Assess structural mismatch on held-out reactor data.

capabilities.title: Held-out model/data discrepancy constraints
capabilities.summary: Fail-closed held-out discrepancy constraints work, but production measurements, benchmark metrics and authoritative MODEL_FORM UQ promotion are intentionally absent.
next_actions: Exercise against real pinned measurement packs.
Add benchmark coverage metrics.
Design a separate authoritative MODEL_FORM uncertainty producer rather than promoting these bounds directly.

real_data.next_action: Run the protocol on pinned production measurement packs rather than fixtures only.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Create a public discrepancy benchmark with coverage/failure metrics.

parameter_uq.rationale: This analysis consumes declared prediction uncertainty; it is not the producer of parameter uncertainty.

numerical_uq.rationale: This analysis consumes declared prediction uncertainty; it is not the producer of numerical uncertainty.

claims_integration.next_action: Keep the candidate non-authoritative but expose diagnostics/repair flow to claim assessment where appropriate.

domainpack_integration.rationale: This is a generic claims-analysis capability, not domain-owned physics.

capabilities.title: Domain Pack v1
capabilities.summary: Atomic manifest/provider/registry/discovery/snapshot infrastructure exists, but planner consumption and a real external package workflow are not complete.
next_actions: Add a real external test package through Python entry points.
Wire enabled packs into planner/model selection.
Add ambiguity refusal and compatibility migration integration tests.
Normalize Thermal and Electrical only after the contract is exercised externally.

scientific_definition.rationale: Domain Pack is platform infrastructure, not a physical/scientific model.

applicability.rationale: Domain Pack is platform infrastructure; compatibility is governed by its API/manifest contract.

real_data.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not require scientific measurement data.

calibration.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not fit scientific parameters.

independent_validation.next_action: Package and load at least one real external forge.domainpacks distribution in an integration test.

measurement_uq.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not produce measurement uncertainty.

benchmark_metrics.next_action: Add discovery/load/validation/selection integration benchmarks and compatibility regression fixtures.

parameter_uq.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not produce parameter uncertainty.

numerical_uq.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not run numerical physics.

model_discrepancy.rationale: Plugin infrastructure does not produce model discrepancy.

claims_integration.next_action: Make the planner consume explicitly enabled DomainPack providers rather than concrete domain internals.

domainpack_integration.rationale: This capability is the Domain Pack infrastructure itself.
